# Airschool API full documentation

> Airschool product guides, integration workflows, MCP documentation, and public API reference.
> This is the full public, navigable preview corpus. It remains intentionally noindex for traditional search engines.

## Scrape a Sales Navigator search

Source: https://airscale.mintlify.app/docs/sales-navigator.md

Description: Turn your Sales Navigator searches (people only) into actionable prospect lists in Airschool. This feature extracts profiles directly from any Sales Navigator search results, eliminating manual copy-pasting and building targeted lists in minutes

**Note:**

- You can only export **2,500 leads** per search
- We recommend not scraping more than **2,500 leads every 12 hours**

## 0. Prerequisites

- An active LinkedIn Sales Navigator subscription
- A completed search in Sales Navigator with your target prospects
- Airschool Chrome [extension](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/airscale-cookie-importer/hklojeelolieobofdgnboacmigmnkbop) installed (for LinkedIn authentication)

## 1. Click on "Scrape Sales Navigator search results"

![Scrape a Sales Navigator search — 1. Click on "Scrape Sales Navigator search results"](/images/docs/QOaeXVyISyw1AyU6ldpBtDjvzB4.png)

## 2. Copy the search URL from Sales Navigator

Before scraping, ensure your search is properly configured:

1. Go to Sales Navigator and perform your lead search
2. Apply your target filters (job titles, company size, industry, location, etc.)
3. Review your search results to ensure they match your ideal prospects
4. Copy the search URL from your browser's address bar

![Scrape a Sales Navigator search — 2. Copy the search URL from Sales Navigator](/images/docs/dMBQCqCanAHC0lKoycTMqCD4.png)

## 3. Connect your LinkedIn account

Download the Airschool Chrome extension if you haven't already [here](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/airscale-cookie-importer/hklojeelolieobofdgnboacmigmnkbop) or directly with the link on the extraction page

- The extension will automatically extract your LinkedIn session cookie
- Paste your `li_at` cookie into the provided field
- This authenticates your LinkedIn session securely. 2FA adds an extra security layer and is required for Admin roles

![Scrape a Sales Navigator search — 3. Connect your LinkedIn account](/images/docs/S5lbwdKwJwMx7duJbf6TwyeDaE.png)

```text
# Example cookie value:
AQEFARABAAAAABh3zC8AAAGax5RR6wAAAZsS5x4vTgAAs3wcms4QjA4ZWtWSUZxNDRZQVVJNGdSZHk1bE41a[..]
```

## 4. Launch the extraction

Click **"LAUNCH EXTRACTION"** to begin the scraping process

1. Monitor the progress in real-time on the right panel:

   - Validating your LinkedIn session cookie
   - Extracting (progress will show here)
   - Importing results to a table
2. Wait for completion — most extractions complete within 1–10 minutes

![Scrape a Sales Navigator search — 4. Launch the extraction](/images/docs/aw6ZDObeaXmjx1HYCcY47fVoZ8.png)

## 5. Access your results

Click **"See your results"** to view your new prospect table:

![Scrape a Sales Navigator search — 5. Access your results](/images/docs/14R4NiRR8nITFmts0EKUSJ5y4.png)

**Output format:**

| **Field** | **Data level** | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| First Name | People | / |
| Last Name | People | / |
| Company Name | Company | / |
| Job title | People | / |
| Location | People | / |
| Linkedin Profile URL | People | / |
| Linkedin Company URL | Company | / |
| Open? | People | / |
| Premium? | People | / |

---

## Extract post likers/commenters

Source: https://airscale.mintlify.app/docs/likers-commenters.md

Description: Find highly engaged prospects by extracting users who have liked or commented on specific LinkedIn posts. This powerful feature helps you identify people already interested in topics relevant to your business, making them warmer prospects for outreach

**Note:** you can extract up to **3000 post likers/commenters** at once

## 0. Prerequisites

- Access to LinkedIn (personal or Sales Navigator account)
- Specific LinkedIn posts with engagement (likes/comments) to target

## 1. Click on "Extract LinkedIn post likers and commenters"

1. Log into your **Airschool account**
2. Select **"Extract LinkedIn post likers and commenters"** from the available options in the **"Find People"** tab

![Extract post likers/commenters — 1. Click on "Extract LinkedIn post likers and commenters"](/images/docs/mTeyja6PKB6NJK40FPIlseAoGsE.png)

## 2. Copy the URL of the post

Identify and prepare your target LinkedIn post:

1. **Find a relevant LinkedIn post** with good engagement:

   - Industry thought leadership content
   - Company announcements from competitors
   - Product launches or feature updates
   - Industry news or trend discussions
2. **Copy the post URL:**

   - Navigate to the specific LinkedIn post
   - Click on the post timestamp to open the individual post view
   - Copy the full URL from your browser's address bar
   - URL should look like: `https://www.linkedin.com/posts/[username]_[post-id]`
3. **Give your extraction a descriptive name:**

   - Example: "SaaS CEO Post Engagement | Q1 2024 | Marketing Automation"
   - Include the post topic and date for easy reference
4. **Paste the post URL** into the designated field in Airschool

**Pro tip:** choose posts with **50+ engagements** for a meaningful prospect list, but avoid **super viral posts** (3000+ engagements) that may contain less targeted audiences

![Extract post likers/commenters — 2. Copy the URL of the post](/images/docs/4PVO3KHqPr9ebCdzQMohTCvUQ.png)

![Extract post likers/commenters — 2. Copy the URL of the post](/images/docs/ka9IHgnXGXmlJZYm33USvTWtAg.png)

## 3. Launch the extraction

**Click "LAUNCH EXTRACTION"** to begin the scraping process

1. **Monitor progress in real-time:**

   - Validating post access and engagement data
   - Extracting user profiles from engagement
   - Processing and importing results
2. **Wait for completion** — most extractions complete within 1–5 minutes

**Pro tip:** you can navigate away from this page during extraction

![Extract post likers/commenters — 3. Launch the extraction](/images/docs/66wC8gsh7AEcMAoLPDzP21Yfc.png)

## 4. Access your results

**Click "See your results"** to view your engagement-based prospect table:

![Extract post likers/commenters — 4. Access your results](/images/docs/6oSpKvBKPVim0F3DZY0SGr3fU.png)

---

## Single Search

Source: https://airscale.mintlify.app/docs/single-search.md

Description: Extract people profile information from a LinkedIn URL and find emails and/or phone number

## 1. Click on "Single Search"

![Single Search — 1. Click on "Single Search"](/images/docs/t4wm0y2IGeG2OxYVw1J3zWWxAlE.png)

## 2. Copy the profile URL of a profile and paste it below

![Single Search — 2. Copy the profile URL of a profile and paste it below](/images/docs/03S62s6Q6XiRIbWcWuauIcUEg8U.png)

## 3. Specify whether you want to find their professional email and phone numbers

**Note:** you can toggle ON/OFF options to find emails and phone numbers

![Single Search — 3. Specify whether you want to find their professional email and phone numbers](/images/docs/wzJsa14q3rdIXjP9TkXGAXTh5sE.png)

## 4. Launch the extraction and export the profile to a table

- **Click "EXTRACT PROFILE"** to begin the scraping process
- After a few seconds, we will retrieve the data about the profile, and the results will appear on the right side of the screen

![Single Search — 4. Launch the extraction and export the profile to a table](/images/docs/w88qp3aqGy6JaQSzGyUr8dzniSY.png)

## Leads finder

Source: https://airscale.mintlify.app/docs/leads-finder.md

Description: Export up to 10,000 leads in one search from various filters

<iframe
  className="w-full aspect-video rounded-xl"
  src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/Uq8zO5r8qjQ?iv_load_policy=3&amp;rel=0&amp;modestbranding=1&amp;playsinline=1&amp;autoplay=0&amp;mute=1"
  title="Leads finder video walkthrough"
  allow="accelerometer; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture"
  allowFullScreen
></iframe>

**Note**

- You can import up to **10,000 people** per search
- Large searches may take several minutes to complete
- Use specific filters to get the most relevant results within the limit

## 0. Prerequisites

- An active Airschool account with remaining credits
- Clear understanding of your ideal customer profile (ICP)
- Specific criteria for your target prospects (people and company attributes)

## 1. Click on "Leads finder"

1. Log into your **Airschool** dashboard
2. Select **"Leads finder"** from the available modules (look for the Airschool logo icon)

**Note:** the "Leads finder" module is Airschool's native search engine, so you don't need any **external URLs or account connections**

![Leads finder — 1. Click on "Leads finder"](/images/docs/cqquFwDcJVTxgRdn407eEVXmiM.png)

## 2. Apply your search filters

Configure your search criteria using the available filters:

### People Filters

- Current company (you can select an Airschool table containing a list of companies, or use the manual input to enter them manually)
- Job titles
- Seniority level & Experience
- People Location
- Skills
- Language
- Certification
- Keywords in profile
- Profile Badge

### Company Filters

- Company industry
- Company size
- Company headquarter location
- Company type
- Annual revenue
- Keywords in profile
- Founded year range
- Funding
- Employee by department
- Headcount Growth

![Leads finder — Company Filters](/images/docs/6BLagRkGcqX8ioUrfO624P3K1w.png)

## 3. Visualize your results

**Click on "Preview search results"** to see a sample of your search results

1. **Review the preview data:**

   - Names and current job titles
   - Company names
   - Geographic locations
   - Linkedin URLs
2. **Check the results summary:**

   - Total number of matches (e.g., "25 of 558,008 total")
   - Quality of matches against your criteria
3. **Refine filters if needed:**

   - Add or remove people or company attributes based on preview results
   - Modify or refine location targeting for better coverage

**Note:** ensure the preview shows **relevant prospects before importing**. Poor preview results indicate filters need adjustment

![Leads finder — 3. Visualize your results](/images/docs/5EQyGnGy2IvWWQcju2S8W9fM2nQ.png)

## 4. Launch the search

1. **Click "Load all people to a table"** to export the full search to a table
2. **Monitor the import progress:**

   - Progress indicator shows "Importing: X/10 000"
   - Percentage completion display
   - Real-time status updates
3. **Wait for completion:**

   - You can navigate away during processing

**Note:** the system **automatically stops at 10,000 results** even if more matches exist. Use more specific filters if you hit this limit and want different prospects

![Leads finder — 4. Launch the search](/images/docs/dvVGNpKtk9dnxFi924XUaSptL2Q.png)

## 5. Access your results

**Click on "Access results"** to view your new prospect table:

![Leads finder — 5. Access your results](/images/docs/B5CPv1EowcyT3yGiNOpxFA9HuVA.png)

---

## Find People

Source: https://airscale.mintlify.app/docs/find-people.md

Description: Use Airschool's built-in people search to discover prospects based on company, job title, location, and other criteria. This powerful native feature helps you build targeted prospect lists without needing external tools or complex imports

**Note**

- You can import up to **2,500 people** per search
- Large searches may take several minutes to complete
- Use specific filters to get the most relevant results within the limit

## 0. Prerequisites

- An active Airschool account with remaining credits
- Clear understanding of your ideal customer profile (ICP)
- Specific criteria for your target prospects (job titles, company names, locations)

## 1. Click on "Find People"

1. Log into your **Airschool** dashboard
2. **Select "Find people"** from the available modules (look for the Airschool logo icon)

**Note:** the Find People module is Airschool's native search engine, so you don't need any **external URLs or account connections**

![Find People — 1. Click on "Find People"](/images/docs/mle4EpGmEFDRl9D3kRSsD8ZBCIY.png)

## 2. Apply your search filters

Configure your search criteria using the available filters:

### Company Filters

1. **Choose your query method:**

   - **Manual input:** type company domains (e.g., `hubspot.com` or `facebook.com`)
   - **Airschool table:** select from an existing companies list in your tables, then select the column to use to identify the companies (it’s always best to choose the LinkedIn URL to get more accurate results)

### People Filters

1. **Job titles (required):**

   - **Job titles to include:** add specific titles like "Founder," "CEO," "Marketing Director"
   - **Job titles to exclude:** remove irrelevant titles to improve targeting
   - Use the **"Remove all jobs"** option to reset selections
2. **Location targeting:**

   - **Country, city or state to include:** enter geographic filters
   - Type locations like "United States," "San Francisco," or "California"
   - Multiple locations can be added

![Find People — People Filters](/images/docs/O0hXTEvD132vqvZsssKTQFpgQcU.png)

## 3. Visualize your results

**Click on "PREVIEW PEOPLE"** to see a sample of your search results.

1. **Review the preview data:**

   - Names and current job titles
   - Company names and details
   - Geographic locations
   - Profile completeness
2. **Check the results summary:**

   - Total number of matches (e.g., "25 of 558,008 total")
   - Quality of matches against your criteria
   - Geographic and title distribution
3. **Refine filters if needed:**

   - Add or remove job titles based on preview results
   - Adjust company size or industry filters
   - Modify location targeting for better coverage

**Note:** ensure the preview shows **relevant prospects before importing**. Poor preview results indicate filters need adjustment

![Find People — 3. Visualize your results](/images/docs/UBtdKbKF9lQwePorSv3AIk0Omzw.png)

## 4. Launch the search

1. **Click "Load all people to a table"** to export the full search
2. **Monitor the import progress:**

   - Progress indicator shows "Importing: X/2500"
   - Percentage completion display
   - Real-time status updates
3. **Wait for completion:**

   - You can navigate away during processing

**Note:** the system **automatically stops at 2,500 results** even if more matches exist. Use more specific filters if you hit this limit and want different prospects

![Find People — 4. Launch the search](/images/docs/bJTNAQ2ZU9ssoGFvVVRmxEg9s.png)

## 5. Access your results

**Click on "See your results"** to view your new prospect table:

![Find People — 5. Access your results](/images/docs/9KdqHeA1H3o7WWpAED7xm8rCy4.png)

---

## Find Companies

Source: https://airscale.mintlify.app/docs/find-companies.md

Description: Use Airschool's built-in company search to discover target businesses based on size, industry, location, and other firmographic criteria. This native feature helps you build comprehensive company lists for account-based prospecting and market research

<iframe
  className="w-full aspect-video rounded-xl"
  src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/CJCFoMy_1sU?iv_load_policy=3&amp;rel=0&amp;modestbranding=1&amp;playsinline=1&amp;autoplay=0&amp;mute=1"
  title="Find Companies video walkthrough"
  allow="accelerometer; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture"
  allowFullScreen
></iframe>

**Note:**

- You can import up to **10,000 companies** per search
- Large searches may take several minutes to complete
- Use specific filters to get the most relevant companies within the limit

## 0. Prerequisites

- An active Airschool account with remaining credits
- Clear understanding of your ideal customer profile (ICP)
- Specific criteria for your target companies (industry, size, location, etc.)

## 1. Click on "Find Companies"

- Log into your **Airschool** dashboard
- **Select "Find companies"** from the available modules (look for the Airschool icon)

**Note:** the Find Companies module is Airschool's native search engine, so you don't need any external URLs or account connections

![Find Companies — 1. Click on "Find Companies"](/images/docs/JPMGGavgTaLa4qXjv6IQT7RTIg.png)

## 2. Apply your search filters

Configure your search criteria using the comprehensive filter system:

### Basic company filters

**Company industry:**

- Select from dropdown of industry categories
- Multiple industries can be selected
- Focus on industries where your solution has proven success

**Company size:**

- Choose from predefined ranges: 1-10, 11-50, 51-200, 201-500, 501-1000, 1001-5000, 5001-10000
- Select multiple ranges for broader targeting
- Consider your product's sweet spot for company size

**Headquarter location targeting:**

- Include country, state, or city: Enter geographic filters like "United States," "California," or "San Francisco"
- Multiple locations can be added for broader coverage
- Use specific cities for territory-based targeting

**Company number of locations & company age:**

- Set minimum and maximum number of office locations as well as company age in years
- Target single-site startups or multi-location enterprises depending on your ideal customer profile
- Align outreach with companies at the right maturity and operational complexity for your solution

![Find Companies — Basic company filters](/images/docs/GNzzXexOisk69kbX1VHyoNN3M.png)

### Advanced growth filters & signals

**Company recent events:**

- Select multiple recent events simultaneously:

  - *Hiring in a specific department*
  - *Increase in a specific department*
  - *Decrease in a specific department*
  - *Company award*
  - *New product*
  - *Employee joined company*
  - *Merger and acquisitions*
  - *Lawsuit and legal issues*
  - *Outages and security breaches*
  - *Closing office*
  - *New investment*
  - *New office*
  - *New partnership*
  - *Cost cutting*
  - *New funding round*
  - *Award*
  - *IPO announcement*
- Identify companies going through strategic shifts or growth phases
- Prioritize outreach based on timely, contextual triggers
- Filter by last occurrence : 30, 60, or 90 days

**Company revenue:**

- Set minimum and maximum revenue in millions
- Target companies within specific revenue ranges
- Align with your solution's typical customer spend capacity

**Topics recently searched:**

- Select specific topics or keywords recently searched by target companies
- Identify businesses actively researching solutions in your space
- Prioritize outreach based on real-time intent signals to reach prospects at the right moment in their buying journey

**Company tech stack:**

- Select specific technologies used by target companies (CRM, marketing tools, sales tools, infrastructure, etc.)
- Filter companies based on their current tech stack to identify integration opportunities or competitive displacement
- Target businesses already familiar with similar solutions to reduce onboarding friction

![Find Companies — Advanced growth filters & signals](/images/docs/3CF93jgX4Q9NQkYoPc3XqnIFck.png)

### Advanced keyword targeting

**Keywords in website:**

- Enter specific keywords to target companies whose website content matches your criteria
- Identify businesses operating in niche industries or verticals based on their own messaging
- Reach companies that explicitly address topics relevant to your solution on their public pages

## 3. Visualize your results

**Click "PREVIEW COMPANIES"** to see a sample of your search results.

1. **Review the preview data:**

   - Company names
   - Company website
   - Company location
2. **Check the results summary:**

   - Total number of matches
   - Quality of matches against your ICP
   - Distribution across industries and business models
3. **Refine filters if needed:**

   - Adjust keyword combinations based on company descriptions
   - Modify industry selections for better targeting
   - Update size or revenue ranges based on company profiles
   - Fine-tune company events for ideal timing

**Note:** ensure the preview shows **relevant companies before importing**. Poor preview results indicate filters need adjustment

![Find Companies — 3. Visualize your results](/images/docs/EfJJiiHwZKdE9Zqxstah0yrjJg.png)

## 4. Click on "Load all companies to a table" to create a new table

**Review your final filter settings** one more time

1. **Click "Load all companies to a table"** to export the full search
2. **Monitor the import progress:**

   - Progress indicator shows "Importing: X/10,000"
   - Percentage completion display
   - Real-time status updates
3. **Wait for completion:**

   - You can navigate away during processing

**Note:** the system automatically stops at **10,000 results** even if more matches exist. Use more specific filters if you hit this limit and want different prospects

![Find Companies — 4. Click on "Load all companies to a table" to create a new table](/images/docs/JXEnxUGXAX2po1p59KVF32c.png)

## 5. See your results

**Click on "Access results"** to view your new company table:

![Find Companies — 5. See your results](/images/docs/tNlmlneySCEqUJ8k9GDqtSoq7Yg.png)

You can now start enriching!

## Find Companies (Linkedin)

Source: https://airscale.mintlify.app/docs/find-companies-linkedin.md

Description: Use Airschool’s real-time LinkedIn scraping module to discover target companies based on size, industry, location, and other firmographic criteria. This powerful add-on continuously extracts fresh company data from LinkedIn, helping you build accurate prospecting lists for account-based sales and market research.

**Note:**

- You can import up to **1,000 companies** per search
- Large searches may take several minutes to complete
- Use specific filters to get the most relevant companies within the limit

## 0. Prerequisites

- An active Airschool account with remaining credits
- Clear understanding of your ideal customer profile (ICP)
- Specific criteria for your target companies (industry, size, location, etc.)

## 1. Click on "Find Companies (LinkedIn)"

- Log into your **Airschool** dashboard
- **Select "Find companies (LinkedIn)"** from the available modules (look for the LinkedIn logo)

![Find Companies (Linkedin) — 1. Click on "Find Companies (LinkedIn)"](/images/docs/jTFkcwzh6MLCjE5uHeLPcxgXz0.png)

## 2. Apply your search filters

Configure your search criteria using the comprehensive filter system:

### Basic company filters

**Location targeting:**

- **Include country, state, or city:** Enter geographic filters like "United States," "California," or "San Francisco"
- Multiple locations can be added for broader coverage
- Use specific cities for territory-based targeting

**Company industries:**

- Select from dropdown of industry categories
- Multiple industries can be selected
- Focus on industries where your solution has proven success

**Company size:**

- Choose from predefined ranges: 1-10, 11-50, 51-200, 201-500, 501-1000, 1001-5000, 5001-10000
- Select multiple ranges for broader targeting
- Consider your product's sweet spot for company size

### Advanced growth and financial filters

**Company size growth:**

- Set minimum and maximum growth percentages
- Target companies experiencing specific growth rates
- Filter for rapidly expanding businesses or stable enterprises

**Company signals:**

- Select from dropdown of buying intent and behavioral signals
- Target companies showing signs of growth, hiring, or technology adoption
- Focus on businesses likely to be in market for your solution

**Company revenue:**

- Set minimum and maximum revenue in millions
- Target companies within specific revenue ranges
- Align with your solution's typical customer spend capacity

### Department-specific filters

**Company department count:**

- Select specific departments (Sales, Marketing, Engineering, etc.)
- Set minimum and maximum employee counts within those departments
- Target companies with mature departments in your focus area

**Company department growth:**

- Choose specific departments experiencing growth
- Set minimum and maximum growth percentages for those departments
- Identify companies actively hiring in relevant areas

**Company followers count:**

- Select a specific range of follower count on LinkedIn
- Target companies with strong brand presence or niche audiences
- Filter by growth stage based on community size

### Advanced keyword targeting

**Keywords filter:** Use sophisticated keyword combinations to find companies with specific business models or strategies.

**Business model examples:**

- `freemium AND self-serve AND PLG` (Product-Led Growth companies)
- `subscription AND SaaS AND upselling` (SaaS businesses)
- `shopify AND DTC AND ecommerce` (Direct-to-consumer brands)

**Go-to-Market strategy examples:**

- `(cold email OR cold call) AND B2B AND outbound` (Outbound sales focus)
- `(ABM OR demand gen) AND enterprise` (Account-based marketing)

**Technology focus examples:**

- `AI AND chatbot AND customer support` (AI customer service)
- `fintech AND KYC AND compliance` (Financial technology)
- `logistics AND warehouse AND last mile` (Supply chain/logistics)

**Sustainability examples:**

- `sustainability AND green energy AND carbon` (Green technology)

**Pro Tip:** you don't need to press enter when typing keyword combinations. Just type the keywords and Boolean operators directly (AND/OR)

![Find Companies (Linkedin) — Advanced keyword targeting](/images/docs/swMcOSNiTQ298IsdKSrWcDnKRE.png)

## 3. Visualize your results

**Click "PREVIEW COMPANIES"** to see a sample of your search results.

1. **Review the preview data:**

   - Company names: check if businesses match your target market
   - Industry classifications: verify industry relevance to your solution
   - Company descriptions: review business models and focus areas
   - LinkedIn profile URLs: validate company authenticity and presence
2. **Check the results summary:**

   - Total number of matches
   - Quality of matches against your ICP
   - Distribution across industries and business models
3. **Refine filters if needed:**

   - Adjust keyword combinations based on company descriptions
   - Modify industry selections for better targeting
   - Update size or revenue ranges based on company profiles
   - Fine-tune growth criteria for ideal timing

**Note:** ensure the preview shows **relevant companies before importing**. Poor preview results indicate filters need adjustment

![Find Companies (Linkedin) — 3. Visualize your results](/images/docs/qVDao0MlaUzH9rCFNt0AcJ5Tg.png)

## 4. Click on "Load all companies to a table" to create a new table

**Review your final filter settings** one more time

1. **Click "Load all companies to a table"** to export the full search
2. **Monitor the import progress:**

   - Progress indicator shows "Importing: X/1000"
   - Percentage completion display
   - Real-time status updates
3. **Wait for completion:**

   - You can navigate away during processing

**Note:** the system automatically stops at **1,000 results** even if more matches exist. Use more specific filters if you hit this limit and want different prospects

![Find Companies (Linkedin) — 4. Click on "Load all companies to a table" to create a new table](/images/docs/MCxC1XuMQudqQnZBsC4ugBzefZM.png)

## 5. See your results

**Click on "Access results"** to view your new company table:

![Find Companies (Linkedin) — 5. See your results](/images/docs/XJaPhrGOzUMTRGQd4JsW87CynI.png)

You can now start enriching!

Source: https://airscale.mintlify.app/docs/google-maps.md

Description: Find local businesses with Google Maps directly in Airschool. Extract names, addresses, phones and emails in one click to fuel your prospecting lists.

**Note:** you can only import **500 local businesses** per search

## 1. Click on "Find local businesses with Google Maps"

![Find local businesses with Google Maps — 1. Click on "Find local businesses with Google Maps"](/images/docs/Fakc8ikpOHeLY1R724FGrnYtK8.png)

## 2. Add the search filters

- **Apply your target filters:** location and business type
- **Optionally**, you can also ask to find the contact information of the businesses. When toggled ON, we will scrape each company’s website and return any available contact details (emails, phone numbers)

![Find local businesses with Google Maps — 2. Add the search filters](/images/docs/BdejNnRNyfZCbadXFKpvkgnGNfw.png)

## Find companies hiring for specific positions

Source: https://airscale.mintlify.app/docs/companies-hiring.md

Description: Find companies hiring for specific positions using Airschool. Target the right accounts at the right time and reach out when hiring intent is highest.

**Note:** you can only import up to **1,000 companies** per search

## 1. Click on "Find companies hiring for a specific position"

![Find companies hiring for specific positions — 1. Click on "Find companies hiring for a specific position"](/images/docs/eIc2Yoaw65kiCyN9tGRLZtKQ1B8.png)

## 2. Add your search filters

Use the following filters to refine your search:

- **Query:** "Head of Growth", "Data Analyst", etc.
- **Company Headcount:** filter by size to match your ICP (e.g., 11–50, 51–200)
- **Industry:** target relevant industries (e.g., Health, Consumer Services, etc.)
- **Location:** focus on specific countries, regions, or cities
- etc.

## 4. Launch the extraction and access your results

Click on **"Load companies to a table"** to begin the scraping process and load the companies to an Airschool table

![Find companies hiring for specific positions — 4. Launch the extraction and access your results](/images/docs/RS1tl0ZjLBcysSlaNTBbqaSoU.png)

## Find professional emails

Source: https://airscale.mintlify.app/docs/professional-emails.md

Description: Find verified emails via Airschool's waterfall enrichment

**Note:** the required input to find an email is the combination of:

- First name
- Last name
- Company name **or** company domain

**OR**

- People LinkedIn URL

## 1. Select the enrichment

![Find professional emails — 1. Select the enrichment](/images/docs/MKWxPcKTelmTyEN8thlYLfJK8w.png)

## 2. Select the rows to enrich

![Find professional emails — 2. Select the rows to enrich](/images/docs/mjAW0iR4zacTpKaZowgRvAI2yxY.png)

## 3. Run the workflow

![Find professional emails — 3. Run the workflow](/images/docs/KYliLhgWS3vzOmCJ7eUWjaLLRQ.png)

## 4. Access the results

Once the enrichment is complete, you can see which provider returned the verified email by clicking on **"Details"**

**Note:**

**Email status indicators:**

- **Deliverable:** email exists and is safe to contact
- **Not found:** no email address could be found
- **Risky:** email found but deliverability uncertain (often catch-all domains)
- **Found:** email address discovered and verified

**Deliverability classifications:**

- **Deliverable:** high confidence — safe for outreach campaigns
- **Risky (Catch-All):** use with caution: this domain accepts all emails, but the specific address may be invalid
- **Not Deliverable:** remove from campaigns to protect sender reputation

![Find professional emails — 4. Access the results](/images/docs/Dn5CmCKdR5hQY7DnwQazqHD5wU.png)

## AI custom prompts

Source: https://airscale.mintlify.app/docs/ai-custom-prompts.md

Description: Run AI with the best LLMs using custom prompts

## 1. Select the enrichment called "Use AI"

![AI custom prompts — 1. Select the enrichment called "Use AI"](/images/docs/GAiQ1tczEoDfWACoE2AJETsfg3M.png)

## 2. Select the rows to enrich

![AI custom prompts — 2. Select the rows to enrich](/images/docs/WxlDcIeglXVAgqXaSrLz0EO0d0.png)

## 3. Select the mode (web access vs non web access)

![AI custom prompts — 3. Select the mode (web access vs non web access)](/images/docs/brxgtfaR86PzBI94iG9pOoLYxno.png)

**Note**:

- **No web access:** Best to edit, format, or clean your data. Use this mode when your prompt only needs data already existing in your table and doesn’t need to browse the web to provide the expected output
- **Web access:** Use this mode if you want to find data on the web and want AI to have web browsing capabilities. Useful to research data online about a company or a prospect by visiting website pages (*this mode will select Airsearch 1.0 as the LLM to use)*

## 4. Select an LLM

![AI custom prompts — 4. Select an LLM](/images/docs/Uo3HdyDT13L2dqMmgeuNuB68LY.png)

## 5. Write or import your prompt

![AI custom prompts — 5. Write or import your prompt](/images/docs/CgC4NnkSPb9B6BnTib3HN72IM.png)

**Note**: to use dynamically the content of a column existing in your table, **use the key "/" on your keyboard**

## 6. Run the workflow

When the workflow is launched, **a new column will be created with the output**

![AI custom prompts — 6. Run the workflow](/images/docs/Tk0wwTnzqKNxjeRRqPCRorv7I.png)

## AI agent (AirSearch)

Source: https://airscale.mintlify.app/docs/ai-agent-airsearch.md

Description: Use Airschool’s AI agent to browse the web and find any information about a company or a prospect

## 1. Select the enrichment called "Use AI"

![AI agent (AirSearch) — 1. Select the enrichment called "Use AI"](/images/docs/GAiQ1tczEoDfWACoE2AJETsfg3M.png)

## 2. Select the rows to enrich

![AI agent (AirSearch) — 2. Select the rows to enrich](/images/docs/WxlDcIeglXVAgqXaSrLz0EO0d0.png)

## 3. Select the mode "Web access"

![AI agent (AirSearch) — 3. Select the mode "Web access"](/images/docs/z5fVsD7Ktro54HbAchh08EreJM.png)

**Note**: selecting **“Web access”** mode will automatically choose **“Airsearch 1.0”**, the model required for web access, including browsing and scraping capabilities

## 4. Write or import your prompt

![AI agent (AirSearch) — 4. Write or import your prompt](/images/docs/mdIvWqzGETa0VijChFk2dKyYGqs.png)

**Note**: to dynamically use the content of an existing column in your table, **press the “/” key on your keyboard**

## 5. Run the workflow

![AI agent (AirSearch) — 5. Run the workflow](/images/docs/w6WwJXyF506gUi8bQFysN9ErAI8.png)

## 6. Access the results

**Note**: after launching the enrichment, **two columns will be automatically created** on the right side of the spreadsheet

**In the first column that is created,** you’ll find details about the AI’s reasoning behind the answer. If you click on **“Click to expand,”** you can view the full enrichment details

The enrichment will return 4 keys:

- **Response**: the output for your prompt
- **Reasoning**: the steps taken by the agent to return the output
- **Sources**: the web pages visited in order to gather the data to return the output
- **Confidence score**: a score of confidence to understand how reliable and accurate the output is

![AI agent (AirSearch) — 6. Access the results](/images/docs/olafLLXMfVktfKwcqFu0lDf7L8.png)

![AI agent (AirSearch) — 6. Access the results](/images/docs/sJhZNo7y68WEivaCMH7XKpVGKhI.png)

**In the second column**, you’ll see the result with the output requested in your promp :

![AI agent (AirSearch) — 6. Access the results](/images/docs/KKeaJVoXJXaRlm5890fL9knmhYA.png)

## Export your data as CSV

Source: https://airscale.mintlify.app/docs/export-csv.md

Description: Export your prospect lists from Airschool as CSV files for use in email marketing tools, CRMs, or further analysis. This feature lets you download all enriched data while giving you full control over which contacts and columns to include

##### When to export as CSV

- To launch **email campaigns** in external tools
- To **import data into CRMs** not directly integrated with Airschool
- To **analyze data** in Excel, Google Sheets, or analytics tools
- To **keep local backups** of your prospect data
- To **share prospect lists** across teams and departments

## 1. Click on "Export"

![Export your data as CSV — 1. Click on "Export"](/images/docs/Yvi22e57W5Yy2VlXHI1eglxz2I.png)

## 2. Select "Download as csv"

![Export your data as CSV — 2. Select "Download as csv"](/images/docs/jnxWjgx9VtvP6G46xpFifh8s.png)

## 3. Select the rows to extract

![Export your data as CSV — 3. Select the rows to extract](/images/docs/ubvyllZqZQ9WEerCs4qpaaCfPE.png)

## 4. Select a file extension

Note:

**CSV (recommended):**

- Universal compatibility with most email tools and CRMs
- Smaller file size for large datasets
- Easy to open in Excel, Google Sheets, or text editors
- Best for automated imports and integrations

**XLSX:**

- Excel-native format with formatting preservation
- Better for manual data manipulation
- Supports advanced Excel features if needed
- Slightly larger file size

![Export your data as CSV — 4. Select a file extension](/images/docs/hJQkLQYaU0y5hwk3BE4C7x4sDTE.png)

## 5. Download your export

![Export your data as CSV — 5. Download your export](/images/docs/Wu5T45AcZxBQYRMGK61b36RpFI.png)

## Transfer your data to another table

Source: https://airscale.mintlify.app/docs/transfer-another-table.md

Description: Move prospects between tables within Airschool to organize your data, create targeted segments, or consolidate lists from multiple sources. This feature helps you keep your prospect database clean and well-organized for different campaigns and initiatives

##### When to export to another table

- Creating campaign segments from a master prospect list
- Organizing prospects by persona (decision makers vs. influencers)
- Separating by geography for territory-based sales teams
- Consolidating data from multiple import sources
- Creating backup tables before running bulk enrichments
- Segmenting by deliverability status for different outreach strategies

## 0. Prerequisites

- A source table containing prospect data in Airschool
- An existing destination table

## Export your leads to HubSpot

Source: https://airscale.mintlify.app/docs/export-hubspot.md

Description: Export your prospects directly from Airschool to HubSpot CRM to streamline your sales pipeline. This integration pushes enriched prospect data directly into your HubSpot database, allowing you to manage leads, track interactions, and nurture prospects through your established sales processes

## 0. Prerequisites

- An active HubSpot account with CRM access
- A prospect table in Airschool with email addresses
- HubSpot integration permissions (available on most HubSpot plans)
- Understanding of your HubSpot lead lifecycle stages and contact ownership structure

## 1. Click on "Export"

![Export your leads to HubSpot — 1. Click on "Export"](/images/docs/JhGjlM4TkNoRsWNAASC2x8R53g.png)

## 2. Select "Create or update a contact in HubSpot"

![Export your leads to HubSpot — 2. Select "Create or update a contact in HubSpot"](/images/docs/Zyut9ic592NAu2m5c3gIsbqY.png)

## 3. Select the rows to export

![Export your leads to HubSpot — 3. Select the rows to export](/images/docs/D1fzsaX1h1AKzR51tIdq4fW4HSU.png)

## 4. Connect your Hubspot account

If this is your first time connecting to HubSpot:

1. **Click "Connect your HubSpot account"** in the workflow panel
2. **You'll be redirected to HubSpot's authorization page**
3. **Log into your HubSpot account** if not already logged in
4. **Grant permissions** for Airschool to access your HubSpot CRM
5. **Return to Airschool** once authorization is complete

**HubSpot integration permissions:**

- **Contact creation and updates** for lead management
- **Company association** for account-based tracking
- **Property access** for data mapping and enrichment
- **Pipeline visibility** for lifecycle stage management

**Note** : HubSpot uses OAuth authentication, so you don't need to share passwords or API keys directly

![Export your leads to HubSpot — 4. Connect your Hubspot account](/images/docs/nYMTtVQNYFTZdgRxNp4kPA3igQg.png)

![Export your leads to HubSpot — 4. Connect your Hubspot account](/images/docs/G6dodSmDpA3I8TX0hiTQR7JJKrw.png)

![Export your leads to HubSpot — 4. Connect your Hubspot account](/images/docs/NGLrahEcaEqKSH8qOhuUp0ozpKI.png)

![Export your leads to HubSpot — 4. Connect your Hubspot account](/images/docs/QhLQTMyWoo9hjmR1C57bw0O0eg.png)

## 5. Select a contact owner and lead lifecycle stage

![Export your leads to HubSpot — 5. Select a contact owner and lead lifecycle stage](/images/docs/Bx6sxu4A5uEeSdXsOvAAueAIUk.png)

## 6. Launch your export

![Export your leads to HubSpot — 6. Launch your export](/images/docs/fb9Ev8bng8CS34L94ceODGpef6o.png)

---

## Export your leads to Instantly

Source: https://airscale.mintlify.app/docs/export-instantly.md

Description: Export your prospects directly from Airschool to Instantly campaigns for automated email outreach. This integration streamlines your workflow by pushing enriched prospect data directly into your email sequences without manual uploads or CSV exports.

## 0. Prerequisites

- An active Instantly account with email campaigns set up
- A prospect table in Airschool with enriched email addresses
- Instantly API access (available on most Instantly plans)

## 1. Click on "Export"

![Export your leads to Instantly — 1. Click on "Export"](/images/docs/LYD5VGZ6VGlzyFXpaOiBjzoY.png)

## 2. Select "Add a contact to a campaign in Instantly"

![Export your leads to Instantly — 2. Select "Add a contact to a campaign in Instantly"](/images/docs/IBoQ0zfJHEjaQGtuWU8MLCHFo.png)

## 3. Select the rows to export

![Export your leads to Instantly — 3. Select the rows to export](/images/docs/pSEFwHCK7m1mVv45PNXb3Z6AGsE.png)

## 4. Connect Your Instantly Account

If this is your first time connecting to Instantly:

1. **Click "Connect your Instantly account"** in the workflow panel
2. **Note that "No account connected"** appears initially
3. **You'll need to create an API key** in your Instantly account first

![Export your leads to Instantly — 4. Connect Your Instantly Account](/images/docs/BJPkLZHrV5BC8OR4Swf5F9srXY.png)

## 5. Create API Key in Instantly Settings

**Log into your Instantly account**

1. **Click on "Settings"** (usually in the left sidebar or user menu)
2. **Navigate to "Integrations"** tab
3. **Select "API Keys"** from the available options

![Export your leads to Instantly — 5. Create API Key in Instantly Settings](/images/docs/N1GreSqI72jIlc9dMpMN3QfrzPE.png)

![Export your leads to Instantly — 5. Create API Key in Instantly Settings](/images/docs/aKE7m60wMfe3sd06KG46yD84.png)

## 6. Create your API key

**Click "Create API Key"** button

1. **Name your API key:** Enter a descriptive name like "Export Airschool" or "Airschool Integration"
2. **Select scopes:** Choose "all:all" for full access (required for campaign management)
3. **Click "Create"** to generate your API key

![Export your leads to Instantly — 6. Create your API key](/images/docs/N90KWeh7OLtG5LsoCRe69owG4.png)

![Export your leads to Instantly — 6. Create your API key](/images/docs/QDje3IbObJw8CHvyTrXLuHVUSlU.png)

## 7. Copy your API key

**Copy the generated API key** from the success popup

1. **Store it securely** - you won't be able to see it again after closing the popup
2. **The API key will be a long string** of characters (similar to: "ZWZIYTA4MTktZmZmYy0DNjFmLTk5ZTEtMWJmOWEyNzY4NTFiOmpzWlJYmlb3p...")

**Warning** : copy the API key **immediately** as Instantly won't show it again for security reasons

![Export your leads to Instantly — 7. Copy your API key](/images/docs/YyvBKQgtrr4G7kAVhr6qzOlQ.png)

## 8. Paste API key in Airschool and connect

**Return to Airschool** and the export workflow

1. **Paste your Instantly API key** in the provided field
2. **Click "Connect"** to establish the integration
3. **Wait for confirmation** that the connection was successful

![Export your leads to Instantly — 8. Paste API key in Airschool and connect](/images/docs/2vr8nxATO35rIql8lwQBlEhg.png)

## 9. Select a campaign

![Export your leads to Instantly — 9. Select a campaign](/images/docs/xS9vdSDofJIrwlMIQ9N5qxH28I.png)

## 10. Launch your export

Configure how Airschool data maps to Instantly fields:

- **Email address** ↔ Instantly email field
- **First name** ↔ Instantly first name field
- **Last name** ↔ Instantly last name field
- **Phone** ↔ Instantly phone field
- **Company Name** ↔ Instantly company name field
- **Website** ↔ Instantly website field
- **Additional custom fields** as needed

![Export your leads to Instantly — 10. Launch your export](/images/docs/gnkKiYvdTb90iLqYJf2yJ8k2hk.png)

---

## Import contacts from Hubspot

Source: https://airscale.mintlify.app/docs/import-hubspot.md

Description: Pull contacts from Hubspot lists

**Note:**

- You can only export **10,000 contacts** at once

## 0. Prerequisites

- An active HubSpot account with CRM access
- HubSpot integration permissions (available on most HubSpot plans)

## 1. Click on "Import contacts from Hubspot"

![Import contacts from Hubspot — 1. Click on "Import contacts from Hubspot"](/images/docs/AX6Atx1aWKL2HYHEjhalSps8xQE.png)

## 2. Connect your Hubspot account to Airschool

If this is your first time connecting to HubSpot:

1. **Click "Connect your HubSpot account"** in the workflow panel
2. **You'll be redirected to HubSpot's authorization page**
3. **Log into your HubSpot account** if not already logged in
4. **Grant permissions** for Airschool to access your HubSpot CRM
5. **Return to Airschool** once authorization is complete

**HubSpot integration permissions:**

- **Contact creation and updates** for lead management
- **Company association** for account-based tracking
- **Property access** for data mapping and enrichment
- **Pipeline visibility** for lifecycle stage management

**Note** : HubSpot uses OAuth authentication, so you don't need to share passwords or API keys directly

## Airschool for HubSpot app

Source: https://airscale.mintlify.app/docs/hubspot-app.md

Description: The complete step-by-step guide to install and use the Airschool enrichment app on your HubSpot account.

**What you'll be able to do after the setup:**

- Enrich any HubSpot contact with a verified email and phone number in one click
- Access the enrichment directly from the contact card sidebar
- Automatically update standard HubSpot properties (email, phone)
- Keep a history of enrichment results on each contact

## 0. Prerequisites

- A HubSpot account (any paid plan - Sales Hub Starter or above)
- HubSpot admin rights (to install the app)
- An Airschool account with an active API key - [sign up here](https://app.airscale.io/) if you don't have one

## 1. Install the Airschool app on your HubSpot account

1. Click the button below to launch the secure OAuth installation flow.

[Click here to install Airschool for Hubspot](https://airscale-hubspot.mathis-0d8.workers.dev/oauth/install)

2. On the landing page, click **Connect HubSpot**. If your HubSpot account is hosted in the EU, click the EU link instead.

![Airschool for HubSpot app — 1. Install the Airschool app on your HubSpot account](/images/docs/ecG0P8WSV7MZzzzXKvjSbZSMg.png)

3. **Select your HubSpot account: y**ou'll be redirected to HubSpot. Select the HubSpot account where you want to install Airschool.

![Airschool for HubSpot app — 1. Install the Airschool app on your HubSpot account](/images/docs/FmyGoKzWIlXoCJ4gOw0GshZ0Vek.png)

4. Review and approve the permissions requested (read/write contacts and companies) and click **Connect app**.

![Airschool for HubSpot app — 1. Install the Airschool app on your HubSpot account](/images/docs/SzUROKyfQJGjIZXbzmk0ByYZVQ.png)

**✔️ Installation successful.** At this point, Airschool has automatically created a **Airschool Enrichment** property group on your contact records and added the custom properties needed (`airscale_found_email`, `airscale_found_phone`, `airscale_enrichment_date`, `airscale_email_status`).

## 2. Add your Airschool API key

1. Open any contact record in HubSpot : go to Contacts → select a contact.
2. Locate the Airschool Enrichment card : in the right sidebar, scroll down until you see the **Airschool Enrichment** card. *If you don't see it, go to step 3 to pin it properly.*

![Airschool for HubSpot app — 2. Add your Airschool API key](/images/docs/K7cqhqsrpvr0vHeqsN2FpFksO8c.png)

3. Open the Settings modal : inside the Airschool card, click **Actions → Settings**.

![Airschool for HubSpot app — 2. Add your Airschool API key](/images/docs/QgUv1EMsbFYirDK3s42cU3hrMc0.png)

4. A modal opens : **paste your Airschool API key into the input field**. You can find your API key at [app.airscale.io/dashboard?page=settings&tab=key](https://app.airscale.io/dashboard?page=settings&tab=key).

![Airschool for HubSpot app — 2. Add your Airschool API key](/images/docs/JiKVoexsAsqiyNq8PKT7b7224k.png)

5. Click **Save API Key**. You'll see a green confirmation: *"API key saved successfully."* Close the modal. Setup is complete.

*To remove or replace your API key later: open the Settings modal again, then click Remove API Key (you'll have to click twice within 5 seconds to confirm).*

## 3. Pin the Airschool card to the top (recommended)

By default, HubSpot may place the Airschool card at the bottom of the sidebar. For faster access, pin it to the top.

1. Open any contact record : navigate to contacts and open any contact.
2. At the top of the contact record, click **Customize** (or **Personnaliser** in French). No need to scroll, the button is in the top nav bar.

![Airschool for HubSpot app — 3. Pin the Airschool card to the top (recommended)](/images/docs/3rVl7LL58YCUaxg9oSpRf2cISKY.png)

3. You'll be redirected to a page listing the available views. Click on the **default view** (or the specific view you want to customize).

4. In the sidebar customization panel, locate the **Airschool Enrichment** card and drag it to the top (or just below "About this contact").

![Airschool for HubSpot app — 3. Pin the Airschool card to the top (recommended)](/images/docs/x26RzBgdjqSbPUzpZldYPfggkk.png)

5. Click **Save** at the top right, then refresh the contact page. The Airschool card is now pinned at the top.

***Tip:** This layout applies to all contacts for your user. If you want to apply it team-wide, ask your HubSpot admin to update the default contact record view.*

## 4. Run your first enrichment

1. Open a contact with sufficient data

   Make sure the contact has at least one of the following:

   - **First name + Last name + Company name** (or company domain), OR
   - A **LinkedIn URL** in the field "URL LinkedIn"
2. In the Airschool card, click **Actions**. You have four options:

   | **Action** | **What it does** |
   | --- | --- |
   | **Enrich all** | Finds both email + phone (recommended default) |
   | **Find Email** | Finds verified email only |
   | **Find Phone** | Finds mobile phone only (requires LinkedIn URL) |
   | **Settings** | Opens the API key configuration modal |

![Airschool for HubSpot app — 4. Run your first enrichment](/images/docs/QgUv1EMsbFYirDK3s42cU3hrMc0.png)

3. **Click Enrich All** (a modal opens with a spinner: *"Enriching contact..."*).

![Airschool for HubSpot app — 4. Run your first enrichment](/images/docs/llylGwLFBnZA6qALQBejUF6LHc.png)

4. After a few seconds, you'll see:

   - ✅ **Enrichment complete!** meaning the enrichment request was successfully launched
   - ❌ An error message if something went wrong (e.g. missing input, API key not configured)

![Airschool for HubSpot app — 4. Run your first enrichment](/images/docs/hoxiUVDOAFLDFjANK2ZxosUVsw.png)

5. Refresh to see the new data : close the modal and press **Cmd+R** (Mac) or **Ctrl+R** (Windows) to refresh the page. The new data appears:

   - In the Airschool card: *Found email*, *Found phone*, *Status*, *Enrichment date*
   - In the left sidebar: the standard HubSpot **Email** and **Phone** fields are automatically filled if they were empty

![Airschool for HubSpot app — 4. Run your first enrichment](/images/docs/tL8Dgzb9SteKGRTe1fmR9PQtOyM.png)

#### How the data is written in Hubspot

When Airschool finds an email or phone, the app writes:

**Always, to Airschool custom properties**

- `airscale_found_email`
- `airscale_found_phone`
- `airscale_email_status` (Valid / Risky / Invalid)
- `airscale_enrichment_date`

**Only if empty, to standard HubSpot properties**

- `email` (Email)
- `phone` (Phone number — "Numéro de téléphone")

This means your existing data is **never overwritten**. To force an update of the standard field, use **Actions → Override Email** or **Override Phone** once enrichment has run.

## 5. Automate enrichment with Workflows

Once the Airschool app is installed and your API key is configured, you can automate enrichment at scale using HubSpot Workflows. Instead of enriching contacts one by one, you can set up workflows that automatically enrich contacts based on triggers you define.

**Requirement:** HubSpot Workflows with custom actions require **Sales Hub Pro/Enterprise**, **Marketing Hub Pro/Enterprise**, or **Operations Hub Pro/Enterprise**. This feature is not available on Starter plans.

#### Available workflow actions

Airschool adds three actions to the HubSpot workflow builder:

| **Action** | **What it does** |
| --- | --- |
| **Airschool - Enrich All** | Finds both email + phone (recommended) |
| **Airschool - Find Email** | Finds verified email only |
| **Airschool - Find Phone** | Finds mobile phone only (requires LinkedIn URL on the contact) |

#### How to create an enrichment workflow

1. Create a new workflow: go to **Automation → Workflows → Create workflow**. Select **Contact-based** as the object type.
2. Choose a trigger: select the condition that will start the enrichment. Common examples:

   - **Contact is added to a list**: enrich a batch of imported contacts
   - **Contact fills out a form**: enrich inbound leads automatically
   - **Contact property changes**: e.g., when a LinkedIn URL is added
   - **Manual trigger**: enrich contacts on demand by selecting them manually
3. Add the Airschool action: click the **+** button to add an action. In the search bar, type **"Airschool"**. You'll see the three Airschool actions under **Integrated apps → Airschool Data Enrichment**. Select the one you want (we recommend **"Airschool - Enrich All"** for most use cases).
4. Activate the workflow: click **Review and activate** in the top right corner. Review the settings and click **Activate**. Contacts matching your trigger will now be automatically enriched.

#### Example use cases

| **Use case** | **Trigger** | **Action** |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Enrich all new leads from a form | Contact fills out form "Contact Us" | Airschool - Enrich All |
| Enrich imported contact lists | Contact is added to list "New Import" | Airschool - Enrich All |
| Find phone when LinkedIn is added | LinkedIn URL becomes known | Airschool - Find Phone |
| Enrich contacts entering a deal stage | Associated deal moves to "Discovery" | Airschool - Find Email |

**Credit usage:** Each enrichment in a workflow uses credits from your Airschool account, just like manual enrichment. If your credits run out, the workflow action will return an error for remaining contacts but will not block the rest of the workflow. Monitor your balance at [app.airscale.io](https://app.airscale.io/).

## Troubleshooting

#### The Airschool card doesn't appear on the contact page

- On the contact record, click **Customize** in the top nav → select your view → make sure "Airschool Enrichment" is enabled.
- If it's not in the list, the install may have failed. Reinstall via the install link.

#### "API key not configured" error when enriching

- Open the Airschool card → **Actions → Settings** → paste a valid API key from [app.airscale.io/dashboard?page=settings&tab=key](https://app.airscale.io/dashboard?page=settings&tab=key).

#### "Not enough data to find email" error

- The contact is missing required input. Make sure one of the following is filled:

  - **First name + Last name + (Company name OR company domain)**
  - A **LinkedIn URL** in `hs_linkedin_url` or `linkedin_url`
- Tip: associate a company to the contact in HubSpot. Airschool will use the associated company's domain automatically.

#### "LinkedIn URL is required for phone enrichment"

- Airschool's phone enrichment requires a LinkedIn profile URL to work. Add it to the contact in the **URL LinkedIn** field.

#### The enriched data doesn't show up

- Make sure you refreshed the page (**Cmd+R / Ctrl+R**) after closing the enrichment modal. HubSpot doesn't auto-refresh the sidebar.

#### I don't have enough Airschool credits

- Check your balance at [app.airscale.io](https://app.airscale.io/). Top up via your account settings or contact us.

## Deduplicate leads between tables

Source: https://airscale.mintlify.app/docs/deduplicate-leads-tables.md

Description: Identify and merge duplicate leads between your tables to keep your database clean and accurate

## 0. Prerequisites

- You must have tables with contacts or companies
- Each lead (contact or company) must have a LinkedIn profile URL to be identified, as this is the unique identifier that is used

## 1. Click on "Dedupe" at the bottom left of your table

Launch this workflow and all rows in the current table will be checked for potential duplicates across all your other existing tables. If duplicates are found, the corresponding row in the table will be deleted

![Deduplicate leads between tables — 1. Click on "Dedupe" at the bottom left of your table](/images/docs/By5M1bxsBoCkqXwsRHIOsXHE.png)

![Deduplicate leads between tables — 1. Click on "Dedupe" at the bottom left of your table](/images/docs/aAqwhxs8GBfExpkStDKoRJlG2yc.png)

It may take a few minutes to run entirely if the current table is large. Once the workflow is launched, you can safely close the pop-up as the workflow will be running in the background

**Note**: the dedupe workflow runs within the same object type, contacts with contacts, and companies with companies only

## API Overview

Source: https://airscale.mintlify.app/api-reference/api-overview.md

Description: Authenticate with Airschool and make your first API request.

Use the Airschool API to search for people and companies and enrich contact data from your application.

<CardGroup cols={2}>
  <Card title="Make your first request" href="/api-reference/credit-count">
    Check your workspace's remaining credits with a request that has no body.
  </Card>
  <Card title="Browse endpoints" href="/api-reference/find-people">
    Start with people search, then explore company search and enrichment endpoints.
  </Card>
</CardGroup>

## Make your first request

<Steps>
  <Step title="Create an API key">
    In Airschool, open **Settings → API key** and create a key for your server-side application.
  </Step>
  <Step title="Authenticate">
    Store the key in an environment variable and send it as a Bearer token on every request.

    ```bash
    export AIRSCALE_API_KEY="YOUR_API_KEY"
    ```
  </Step>
  <Step title="Request your credit balance">
    Call `POST https://api.airscale.io/v1/credits` with no body.

    ```bash cURL
    curl --request POST \
      --url https://api.airscale.io/v1/credits \
      --header "Authorization: Bearer $AIRSCALE_API_KEY"
    ```
  </Step>
</Steps>

A successful request returns the remaining workspace balance as a number:

```json
{
  "status": "success",
  "response": {
    "credits": 1200
  }
}
```

## Popular endpoints

<CardGroup cols={2}>
  <Card title="Find people" href="/api-reference/find-people">
    Search for people that match professional filters.
  </Card>
  <Card title="Find companies" href="/api-reference/find-companies">
    Discover companies that match firmographic filters.
  </Card>
  <Card title="Email finder" href="/api-reference/email-finder">
    Find a professional email address from a person's details.
  </Card>
  <Card title="Airsearch" href="/api-reference/airsearch">
    Run an Airsearch request from your application.
  </Card>
  <Card title="Job-change monitors" href="/api-reference/job-change-monitors/create">
    Track LinkedIn profiles and receive employer-change events.
  </Card>
</CardGroup>

Before you build a production integration, review [Authentication](/api-reference/authentication) and [Rate limits](/api-reference/rate-limits).

## Authentication

Source: https://airscale.mintlify.app/api-reference/authentication.md

Description: Create, send, protect, and rotate an Airschool API key.

Airschool authenticates API requests with a workspace API key sent as a Bearer token.

## Create an API key

Create the key in **Airschool Settings**: open the [Airschool dashboard](https://app.airscale.io/dashboard), choose **Settings → API key**, and generate a key for your integration.

Store the value in your server's secret manager or environment configuration:

```bash
export AIRSCALE_API_KEY="YOUR_API_KEY"
```

## Send the key

Include this header on every API request:

```text
Authorization: Bearer $AIRSCALE_API_KEY
```

## Handle unauthorized requests

A missing Bearer token or an invalid API key returns `401 Unauthorized`. Check that the header is present, that it starts with `Bearer`, and that your deployed secret contains the current key before retrying.

<Warning>
Keep API keys server-side. Never commit them to source control, place them in examples, or expose them in browser or mobile client bundles.
</Warning>

## Rotate a compromised key

If a key is exposed, rotate it immediately in **Airschool Settings**. Update the server-side secret, deploy the new value, verify an authenticated request, and stop using the old key.

Next, review [Rate limits](/api-reference/rate-limits) before adding request concurrency or retries.

---

## Rate limits

Source: https://airscale.mintlify.app/api-reference/rate-limits.md

Description: Understand endpoint-specific request limits and 429 responses.

Airschool rate limits are endpoint-specific. Each endpoint can enforce a different request limit and time window, so use the value documented on the endpoint page you are calling.

## Handle rate-limit responses

When a request exceeds an endpoint's limit, the API returns `429 Too Many Requests`. Treat the status code as the rate-limit signal; do not depend on an error field or response header unless that endpoint page documents it.

Only retry when the endpoint page says the operation is safe to retry. Use bounded exponential backoff: cap both the maximum delay and the total number of attempts, then surface a persistent `429` to your application.

## Check an endpoint's limit

Review the request limit on the endpoint page before setting concurrency:

<CardGroup cols={2}>
  <Card title="Find people" href="/api-reference/find-people">
    People search limits and request contract.
  </Card>
  <Card title="Find companies" href="/api-reference/find-companies">
    Company search limits and request contract.
  </Card>
  <Card title="Email finder" href="/api-reference/email-finder">
    Professional email lookup limits and request contract.
  </Card>
  <Card title="Airsearch" href="/api-reference/airsearch">
    Airsearch limits and request contract.
  </Card>
</CardGroup>

---

## Find people

Source: https://airscale.mintlify.app/api-reference/find-people.md

Description: Search people using person, role, and company filters.

Search for people using person, role, current-company, and past-experience filters, then page through the matching lead records.

<Note>
The Search and [Count people](/api-reference/find-people/count) operations share a limit of 6 requests per second per workspace. Search costs 0.1 credits per returned lead; empty result pages are not charged. Count accepts the same `query` for free.
</Note>

Search returns at most 100 leads per request. When `next_cursor` is not `null`, send it unchanged as `cursor` with the same `query`. Do not derive or edit cursor contents.

After a `429`, wait for the next second and retry with bounded exponential backoff. A failed search or credit-service attempt does not return charged leads.

## Next step

Use [Count people](/api-reference/find-people/count) to estimate the audience for free, [Find companies](/api-reference/find-companies) to discover organizations, or [Rate limits](/api-reference/rate-limits) before adding concurrency.

---

## Count people

Source: https://airscale.mintlify.app/api-reference/find-people/count.md

Description: Count people matching person, role, and company filters.

Estimate an audience before retrieving any lead records. Count accepts the same person, role, current-company, and past-experience filters as [Find people](/api-reference/find-people).

<Note>
Count is free. It neither reserves nor debits Airschool credits, and its response contains only the matching total.
</Note>

## Reuse a search audience

Send the same `query` object you plan to use for Find people. Count has no pagination fields because it returns no lead page; keep `size` and `cursor` on the search request instead.

The Count and Find people operations share a limit of 6 requests per second per workspace. After a `429 Too Many Requests` response, wait for the next second and retry with bounded exponential backoff.

<Info>
This preview renders non-executing examples. It does not send a request or ask for an API key.
</Info>

## Next step

Use [Find people](/api-reference/find-people) with the same `query` when you are ready to retrieve the matching records.

---

## Find companies

Source: https://airscale.mintlify.app/api-reference/find-companies.md

Description: Search companies using firmographic, location, event, intent, and technology filters.

Search companies by firmographic, location, event, intent, and technology filters, then page through the matching organizations.

<Note>
Search shares a limit of 6 requests per second per workspace with [Company filter values](/api-reference/find-companies/filter-values). It costs 0.1 credits per returned company; zero returned rows cost zero credits. At least 0.1 credits must be available before Search begins.
</Note>

When `next_cursor` is not `null`, send the exact value unchanged as `cursor` with the same filters. Do not decode, construct, or edit the cursor. Cursor pagination preserves the original page size and can traverse up to 10,000 companies for one search.

After a `429`, wait for the next second and retry with bounded exponential backoff. Retry a settlement failure only after the credit service recovers.

## Next step

Use [Company filter values](/api-reference/find-companies/filter-values) to discover accepted values, [Find people](/api-reference/find-people) to search for roles at identified companies, or [Authentication](/api-reference/authentication) before integrating.

---

## Company filter values

Source: https://airscale.mintlify.app/api-reference/find-companies/filter-values.md

Description: Search supported values for Find Companies filters.

Discover accepted values before adding a city, region, industry, topic, or technology filter to [Find companies](/api-reference/find-companies).

<Note>
Filter-values is free and has no request body. It does not reserve or debit Airschool credits.
</Note>

## Choose useful context

Use `country` and `region` to narrow location suggestions. A bare region name needs country context. The `q` parameter takes precedence when both `q` and its `query` alias are present; a blank `q` still suppresses `query` and returns `400 Bad Request`.

The operation shares a limit of 6 requests per second per workspace with Find companies. After a `429 Too Many Requests` response, wait for the next second and retry with bounded exponential backoff.

<Info>
This preview renders non-executing examples. It does not send a request or ask for an API key.
</Info>

## Next step

Copy the returned `value` into the matching filter on [Find companies](/api-reference/find-companies).

## Airsearch

Source: https://airscale.mintlify.app/api-reference/airsearch.md

Description: Research the web and return structured answers with Airsearch.

Ask a research question and receive a sourced answer, with optional output fields shaped for your application.

<Note>
The limit is 300 requests per minute per workspace. A `success` result costs 1 credit; `not_found` and `timeout` are not charged. The reservation is settled only for `success` and released for the other completed statuses.
</Note>

Requested schema keys are optional and nullable. Structured numeric and boolean values are returned as strings when present, so parse them explicitly when your application requires native scalar types.

A later-stage soft timeout returns `200 OK` with `status: "timeout"`. An initial-stage timeout returns `504 Gateway Timeout`; narrow the prompt before retrying. Use bounded backoff for transient dependency failures.

## Next step

Use [Find companies](/api-reference/find-companies) when the research target should come from structured firmographic filters, or review [Rate limits](/api-reference/rate-limits) before adding parallel requests.

---

## Post likers

Source: https://airscale.mintlify.app/api-reference/post-likers.md

Description: Retrieve and enrich people who liked a LinkedIn post.

Retrieve one synchronous page of people who liked a LinkedIn post, with public profile fields enriched for each returned engagement.

<Note>
Each returned engagement reserves one credit for profile enrichment. A successful enrichment consumes one credit; `not_found` and `error` outcomes remain in the page and are refunded, so they have zero net credit cost.
</Note>

Omit `cursor` on the first request. When `pagination.next_cursor` is not `null`, send that value unchanged with the same post URL and `limit` to fetch the next page. Cursors are bound to the workspace, post, engagement type, and page size, and expire within 15 minutes.

The provider selected for the first page is pinned into the cursor. If a later page returns `503` with `code: "provider_page_unavailable"`, retry the same cursor. The API retries that page against the pinned provider and does not silently switch providers or reorder the result set.

If a response is lost, retrying the request can run the page again and reserve credits again.

After `429 Too Many Requests`, wait and retry with bounded exponential backoff. A failed profile enrichment is refunded, and a failed provider page is not charged.

## Next step

Use [Post commenters](/api-reference/post-commenters) to retrieve people who commented on a LinkedIn post, or read the [post engagement workflow](/docs/likers-commenters) for the dashboard flow.

---

</Note>

Omit `cursor` on the first request. When `pagination.next_cursor` is not `null`, send that value unchanged with the same post URL and `limit` to fetch the next page. Cursors are bound to the workspace, post, engagement type, and page size, and expire within 15 minutes.

The provider selected for the first page is pinned into the cursor. If a later page returns `503` with `code: "provider_page_unavailable"`, retry the same cursor. The API retries that page against the pinned provider and does not silently switch providers or reorder the result set.

If a response is lost, retrying the request can run the page again and reserve credits again.

After `429 Too Many Requests`, wait and retry with bounded exponential backoff. A failed profile enrichment is refunded, and a failed provider page is not charged.

## Email finder

Source: https://airscale.mintlify.app/api-reference/email-finder.md

Description: Find a professional email address for one person.

Identify one person by LinkedIn profile URL or by name and company, then return a verified professional email when one is found.

<Note>
The limit is 3,000 requests per minute per workspace. A successful result costs 2 credits; `not_found` is not charged.
</Note>

At least one complete identification form is required. You may send both forms when you have them.

<Warning>
Use bounded backoff after a transient `502` or `503`. A `503` can mean a successful result could not be settled by the credit service; retry the same input only after the service recovers.
</Warning>

## Next step

Use [Bulk email finder](/api-reference/email-finder-(bulk)) when you need asynchronous results for up to 100 people.

## Bulk email finder

Source: https://airscale.mintlify.app/api-reference/email-finder-(bulk).md

Description: Find professional email addresses for a batch of people.

Submit up to 100 people and receive one asynchronous professional-email result per item at your webhook.

<Note>
The limit is 3,000 input items per minute per workspace. Each item with `status: "success"` costs 2 credits; misses and timeouts are not charged.
</Note>

The acceptance response only confirms that the batch was queued. Processing continues after that response, and each item is delivered separately to `webhook_url`.

## Webhook callbacks

Every callback echoes `custom_id`. When the submitted value is omitted or `null`, Airschool uses that item's zero-based input index.

- A found email has `status: "success"`, the resolved `email`, `email_status: "valid"`, and the public `provider` and `verifier` labels.
- An item skipped after the remaining batch balance drops below 2 credits has `status: "error"`, `error: "insufficient_credits"`, and `email: null`.
- A miss or exhausted lookup has `status: "not_found"` or `status: "timeout"`, respectively, with `email: null`.

<Warning>
Return a `2xx` response promptly for every callback. Automatic webhook retries are not part of this operation's contract, so persist callbacks and use `custom_id` to reconcile expected and received results.
</Warning>

Add credits before submitting skipped items again.

## Next step

Use [Email finder](/api-reference/email-finder) for a synchronous single-person lookup, or review [Rate limits](/api-reference/rate-limits) before batching requests.

The limit is 3,000 requests per minute per workspace. A successful result costs 40 credits; `not_found` is not charged.

## Personal email

Source: https://airscale.mintlify.app/api-reference/personal-email.md

Description: Find a personal email address from a professional profile.

Submit a LinkedIn person profile URL and return a personal email address when one is found.

<Note>
The limit is 2,000 requests per minute per workspace. The minimum balance required to start is 3 credits. A successful result costs between 3 and 12 credits, depending on its source; `not_found` costs 0 credits.
</Note>

<Warning>
If a result is found and charged but required usage recording then fails, the operation returns `502 Bad Gateway`. Check your balance before retrying that input to avoid paying again for the same result.
</Warning>

For other transient failures, retry with bounded backoff. Wait for the credit service to recover before retrying a settlement failure.

## People URL finder

Description: Find a professional profile URL from person and company details.

Identify a person by first name, last name, and company, then return a matching professional profile URL when one is found.

<Note>
The limit is 6 requests per second per workspace. A successful result costs 0.5 credits; `not_found` is not charged.
</Note>

After a `429 Too Many Requests` response, retry in a later second with bounded exponential backoff. Retry transient reservation failures with the same input only after the service recovers.

## People profile

Source: https://airscale.mintlify.app/api-reference/extract-people-profile.md

Description: Extract a structured person profile from a professional profile URL.

Extract a structured person profile from a recognized LinkedIn URL, normally an `/in/` profile.

<Note>
The limit is 3,000 requests per minute per workspace. The submitted URL selects the response schema and successful-call credit cost: `/in/` successes cost 1 credit by default, while `/company/` and `/school/` successes cost 0.5 credits. Workspace-specific pricing can differ, and unsuccessful requests are not charged.
</Note>

The optional modes are `p1`, `p2`, and `p3`. Omit `mode` for the default extraction workflow, whose successful shape can vary; use `p2` or `p3` when you need the normalized schema. The submitted URL, not the route name, selects person versus company output.

Extraction failures return an error rather than a `200 OK` no-result envelope. Retry transient extraction or settlement failures with bounded backoff, and omit `mode` if you do not require a specific mode.

## Next step

Use [Company profile](/api-reference/extract-company-profile) for the organization-focused guidance, or [Email finder](/api-reference/email-finder) to enrich a person profile.

Extract a structured organization profile from a recognized LinkedIn `/company/` or `/school/` URL.

<Note>
The limit is 3,000 requests per minute per workspace. The submitted URL selects the response schema and successful-call credit cost: `/company/` and `/school/` successes cost 0.5 credits, while `/in/` successes cost 1 credit by default. Workspace-specific pricing can differ, and unsuccessful requests are not charged.
</Note>

The optional modes are `p1`, `p2`, and `p3`. Omit `mode` for the default extraction workflow, whose successful shape can vary; use `p2` or `p3` when you need the normalized schema. The submitted URL, not the route name, selects company versus person output.

Extraction failures return an error rather than a `200 OK` no-result envelope. Retry transient extraction or settlement failures with bounded backoff, and omit `mode` if you do not require a specific mode.

The limit is 25 requests per second per workspace. A returned profile costs 2 credits. A miss returns the JSON string `"not found"`, not an object with a status field, and is not charged.

## Reverse phone

Source: https://airscale.mintlify.app/api-reference/reverse-phone.md

Description: Find a person profile from a phone number.

Submit a phone number and receive the matching person profile when one can be resolved.

<Note>
The limit is 2,000 requests per minute per workspace. A returned profile costs 10 credits; `not_found` and errors are not charged.
</Note>

A `not_found` result can represent a true miss or lookup paths that were exhausted or failed. When a match is expected, make one bounded-backoff retry. If it persists, verify that you sent the intended normalized number before retrying again.

Wait for the credit service to recover before retrying a settlement failure with the same number.

## Next step
